text: Training Target:To ensure that your way to China is of no troubles and problems Training Method: Remote Training with Skype : SICAS – China Number of Students/Class: 1-5 Training Introduction: This training is available for the applicants to fully prepare themselves upon arrival to China, so that they can land in China safely and smoothly. The training covers all aspects, from luggage preparation, airline booking, basic language using to flight transfer, custom declaration, university registration, etc. Also, the trainer will answer all of your questions regarding your way to China. An E-predeparture Guide Book will be sent to students via Email as the teaching material. Training Content: 1. Luggage Preparing The training will provide you with all information you need about what can be bought easily and cheaply in China to avoid unnecessary luggage. 2. Travel Plan making Students will be given detailed advice about how to book the cheapest flight ticket and choose the safest airline company. Also, students will be informed of the two tasks (filling in Arrival Form and making friends) on the airplane. 3. Upon Arrival tips The training will equip students with knowledge of airport transit, legal procedures after landing (including how to get Resident Permit, insurance, etc.) university enrollment and registration. 4. Money Matters Information about how to open a student account in China, how to exchange currency and how to manage money matters will also be covered in the training. 5. Familiarize students with the law and regulation of China 6. Q & A In the end of the training, students will be given enough time for all their questions regarding their travel and stay in China.
